title: AI-Integrated Smart Glasses
tagline: Hands-free, real-time feedback from a personal AI agent.
summary: Concepting and prototyping smart glasses that connect to a personal AI agent. I modeled the preliminary frame in SolidWorks and researched the components needed for power and audio and video transmission.

sections.heading: The idea
sections.body: A pair of glasses that connects to a personal AI agent and gives real-time, hands-free feedback through audio and video.

sections.heading: Progress so far
sections.body:
- Modeled the preliminary frame design in SolidWorks.
- Researched the mechanical and electrical components needed to power the glasses and support audio and video transmission.

sections.heading: Next steps
sections.body: Finalize component selection, integrate the electronics into the frame, and build a working prototype for user testing.
